messages:
Samira Patel: Quick check  all-hands in 25. Posting the final go/no-go AV checklist here.
Owen - AV: On-site at 14:05 PT. Roomb batteries charged, 3 spares in the kit. Doing audio sweep in 10.
Priyanka Rao: Can we compress the roadmap to 12m? We need extra time for Q&A.
Samira Patel: Yes, roadmap trimmed to 12m. Q&A extended by 10m at end.
Logan (Platform): Heads-up: streaming ingress will use ingest-stable-3 today. If latency spikes >200ms, fallback to ingest-stable-1.
StreamGuardianBot: :warning: ingest-stable-3 5m average latency 180ms. Recommend monitoring.
Owen - AV: If HD video drops to black, switch to "slides-only" scene and keep audio live. Quick command to flip encoder endpoint:
```
# switch rtmp endpoint
sed -i 's/rtmp:\/\/ingest-stable-3/rtmp:\/\/ingest-stable-1/' /etc/stream/encoder.conf && systemctl restart stream-encoder
```
Clara - Comms: Reminder  slides + transcript to be uploaded within 90 minutes if recording succeeds. If not, transcript + slides within 2 hours.
Devon - EngOps: For any unresolved product Qs, we'll create a follow-up doc and assign owners within 24h. Drop Qs here and we'll collect.
Priyanka Rao: Pre-submitted Q: Will Dedicated burst billing be metered per-minute or per-hour?
Logan (Platform): We'll ask Product live; if not answered we'll follow up with concrete billing examples.
Samira Patel: AV note  avoid scene transitions longer than 250ms to prevent caption lag. Use continuous scene.
Owen - AV: Doing a final mic check now. Levels peak at -6dB. Reducing compression on lectern channel.
StreamGuardianBot: :recording: Recording scheduled to start at 16:00 UTC. Auto-archive to /shared/all-hands/2026-09-03/.
Clara - Comms: Poll for Q ordering pinned in this channel  vote with :thumbsup:. Priority will be Dedicated SLA, Private compliance, Optimize suggestions.
Samira Patel: Great. Tech check in 10. If anything breaks, escalate in #eng-oncall. See you in green room. :thumbsup:
